mapper.sql: payment_id, txn_id, merchant_id, idempotency_key, card_enc, card_hash, card_masked, installment_months, amount, status, result_code, approval_no, approved_at, requested_at, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (txn_id, merchant_id, idempotency_key, card_enc, card_hash, card_masked, installment_months, amount, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{txnId}, #{merchantId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{cardEnc}, #{cardHash}, #{cardMasked}, #{installmentMonths}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{requestedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'APPROVED', result_code = #{resultCode}, approval_no = #{approvalNo}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE txn_id = #{txnId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE payment SET status = #{next}, result_code = #{resultCode}, version = version + 1 WHERE txn_id = #{txnId} AND status = #{expected}
